 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=set()
    for sr in range(h):
      for sc in range(w):
       color=grid[sr][sc]
       if color in (6,): continue
       if (sr,sc) in seen: continue
       stack=[(sr,sc)]; seen.add((sr,sc)); pts=[]
       while stack:
        r,c=stack.pop(); pts.append((r,c))
        for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
         if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc]==color:
          seen.add((nr,nc)); stack.append((nr,nc))
       r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
       if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
       if len(pts) != 2*(r1-r0)+2*(c1-c0): continue
       if not (all(grid[r0][c]==color and grid[r1][c]==color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[r][c0]==color and grid[r][c1]==color for r in range(r0,r1+1))): continue
       area=(r1-r0-1)*(c1-c0-1)
       val=7 if area%2 else 2
       for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1): out[r][c]=val
    return out
"
